how_to_apply: Prepare your bio-data including a valid email ID and mobile phone number.
Gather scanned copies of certificates in proof of qualification, marks, experience, age, caste, etc.
Send the bio-data and scanned certificates via email to [email protected] on or before 16.10.2026.
Take a printout of the bio-data and attach copies of all certificates.
Superscribe the name of the post clearly on the envelope.
Send one set of the bio-data and certificate copies by post to 'The Registrar, Mahatma Gandhi University, P D Hills P O, Kottayam-686560'.
important_instructions: Applications must reach the email address and postal address on or before 16.10.2026. Applications received after the prescribed date will not be considered. The name of the post must be superscribed on the postal envelope and mentioned in the application. Applicants must have their own valid email ID and mobile phone number. Date and time for the interview will be communicated to shortlisted candidates through their email ID or phone. Candidates with experience as a hardware engineer in Mahatma Gandhi University service need not produce an experience certificate, but must submit details regarding their service such as date of entry, section, work experience, and duration.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Mahatma Gandhi University (MGU) is conducting this recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available in the MGU notification 2026?
faq.answer: The notification announces vacancies for Junior Software Developer, Senior Software Developer, and Hardware Engineer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: A total of 8 vacancies are available.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 16.10.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for a Junior Software Developer?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration for a Junior Software Developer is ₹23,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How can I submit my application?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their bio-data and scanned certificate copies to [email protected] and also send one hard copy by post to the Registrar, Mahatma Gandhi University.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for Junior Software Developer?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21-45 years as on 01.01.2026, with relaxations applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates and university experience.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an application fee required?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be notified of the date and time of the interview through their email ID or phone.
